deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This is refused while a time schedule or a zone uses it.
dragHint: Drag entries into the playlist or double-click them.
dropHere: Drop presentations, slides or media here.
durationHint: Repeats until the time is reached; a started pass is finished, not cut off.
publishConfirm: Publish this playlist? Screens whose time schedules use it switch to the new version.
repeatHint: Plays exactly this number of passes.
slideConverted: This entry still had a fixed duration. Single slides now play with their own slide duration; saving changes the entry to repetitions.
slideOwnDuration: A single slide plays with its own slide duration: {time} per pass.
slideOwnDurationUnknown: A single slide plays with its own slide duration.
slideOwnDurationVideo: A single slide plays with its own slide duration: until the video ends, at most {time} per pass.
tracks.durationHint: All tracks move on to the next step together after this time. Shorter videos loop, longer ones are cut.
tracks.hint: Each row is a step with a fixed duration. The screen at place n shows track n, places without a track of their own show track 1. Drag slides or media into the cells; an empty cell shows the same as track 1.
tracks.noPresentations: Whole presentations are only possible in playlists for one screen. Add single slides or media instead.
